statement: At pinned SDL revision, the Xbox One HIDAPI Bluetooth parser has Elite Series 2 paddle layouts for 55-, 39- and 20-byte state packets. It reads the paddle bits and profile-dependent mapped state, suppresses independently exposed paddles when mapped, and otherwise emits four extra joystick buttons. On Linux a parseable HID descriptor may instead take SDL's descriptor-driven path; no binding or delivery was measured.

applicability.revision: Xbox Elite Series 2 model 1797, software-side revision at pinned sources
applicability.scope: SDL_hidapi_xboxone.c:408-458, 947-966, 1278-1286, 1313-1375, 1959-1998. Bluetooth HID and wired GIP are distinct branches.
